title: Fresh Mint Tea
directions: Place tea bags and mint leaves in a 3 quart pitcher. Add 3 cups boiling water and steep until cool. Discard tea bags and mint leaves.
notes: Written on folded notepaper, not a card; different handwriting (not Grandma's usual hand). Continues on next photo.
raw_text:
Fresh Mint Tea
4 tea bags
12 large fresh mint leaves
3 cups boiling water
1 cup orange juice
1/4 cup lemon juice
1 cup sugar
6 cups water
Sprigs of mint
Orange slices

Place tea bags and mint
leaves in a 3 quart pitcher.
Add 3 cups boiling water
and steep until cool. Discard
tea bags and mint leaves.

title: Fresh Mint Tea
directions: Add orange & lemon juices, sugar and 6 cups of water to tea mixture, stirring until sugar is dissolved. Serve over ice and garnish with mint sprigs and orange slices.

title: Overnight Raisin Oatmeal Pancakes
directions: Mix together the oatmeal & buttermilk. Cover & refrigerate overnight.
The next morning, add eggs, butter & raisins. Mix well.
sift tog. flour, sugar, bk. pwd. soda, cinnamon & salt. Add. →
notes: Green card. Arrow at end indicates continues on back (next photo).
raw_text:
Overnight Raisin Oatmeal Pancakes.
2c quick cooking oats          2 tbsp. white sugar.
2c buttermilk                    1 tsp. bk. powder.
2 eggs beaten                    1 tsp.  "  soda.
1/4 c butter softened            1/2 " cinnamon
1/3 c raisins                      1/2 " salt.
1/2 c flour
Mix together the oatmeal & buttermilk. Cover &
refrigerate overnight.
The next morning, add eggs, butter & raisins. Mix well.
sift tog. flour, sugar, bk. pwd. soda, cinnamon & salt. Add. →

title: Overnight Raisin Oatmeal Pancakes
